$comment: EXP-1610 (server half of #EXP-1608): CI on a pull request, provider-neutral. ROWS: `pull_request_checks` = one row per check NAME at the PR's head commit (`head_sha`, `name`, `status` contract prCheckStatus, `conclusion` contract prCheckConclusion or null while running, `required` = a required check of the base branch, `started_at`, `completed_at`, `details_url` = the logs link); a newer head replaces the older head's rows, a late delivery for an older head is dropped. `pull_requests.checks_state` = the aggregate (contract prChecksState, `aggregate` below: none = no rows, failure wins over pending). Both sync (shape `pull-request-checks`, team-scoped, member-only), so no client calls GitHub. WRITERS: GitHub's `check_run` webhook upserts a row; `check_suite`/`workflow_run` `completed` and the next `exponential_pr` read (throttled, one conditional GET of the head's check runs) repair a missed delivery; never a polling loop. Without the App's checks:read permission nothing is known: state none, never an error. eCode's own CI writes the same rows later. WAKE: when `checks_state` turns success or failure (from pending or none), ONE `pr_checks` event line wakes the PR's session (its opener while live, else the thread's root): `CI on #N: success.` / `CI on #N: failure (name (logs url), …).` (`wakeText`), once per PR, head and state. A check still queued `queuedFlagMinutes` (contract prChecks) after it was created is flagged ONCE the same way (`queuedText`). MCP: every `exponential_pr` op returns `checks` = {state, total, failing[{name, url, required}], pending[names]} (`brief`). `pr merge` reports them; with MERGE_CHECK_GATE=true (default off) it refuses while a gated check is red or running (`gate`: the required checks when the base names any, else every check; red first) with `gateText`, and `force: true` merges anyway. Agents never poll api.github.com: they end their turn and the bus wakes them. #EXP-1611 adds the UI x4 (checks list, Merge pill) on this fixture.

queuedText.expected: CI on #7: android-emulator queued for 30+ minutes; no runner picked it up. Tell a person if it stays queued.

gateText.expected: PR #3 has failing checks: gate. Read them, fix and push; merge again when CI is green (force: true merges anyway, only when a person says so).
PR #3 still has checks running: gate, e2e. Do not poll: Exponential wakes this session when CI finishes. Merge then (force: true merges anyway, only when a person says so).
